description: The CanadaBuys web index returned HTTP 403, but the federal Open Government catalogue led to a readable official CSV. The new-notice feed contained 30 records and yielded no title match for catalogue, inventory, spreadsheet or data reconciliation in English or French. That screen covers only newly listed titles. The open-notice feed may contain a live buyer brief worth checking. Commercial feedback reported no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Verified available funds and verified revenue are both CAD 0.
